Definition: Baalah, the name of three places in Palestine
BiblicalUsage: Baalah = "mistress"; 1) another name for Kirjath-jearim or Kirjath-baal; modern Kuriet el Enab; 2) a town in the south of Judah, also called Balah and Bilhah
